title: Illustrative household and birth-registration relationship views
description: Typed Household and Birth Registration Record views with embedded components, related Record references and recorded snapshots. Array bounds belong to these example profiles. Each response contains the complete permitted view within its declared bounds.

IndividualReference.description: Related Record in the fixed target Registry https://registry.example/registries/individuals. registryId may be omitted; an explicit value must match that target. This illustrative field binding resolves through the individuals collection: operation retrieveIndividual in https://registry.example/contracts/1.0.0-draft/examples/individual-registry.openapi.yaml, GET https://registry.example/v1/collections/individuals/records/{recordId}. Supply the referenced recordId as the path parameter, encoded as one segment. The illustrative target contract is not included in these artifacts; target access is evaluated separately.

registryId.description: The same target Registry already fixed by this field's schema.

UnscopedRecordReference.description: Reference field with an explicit target Registry. Both registryId and recordId are required because the field context leaves the target open.

registryId.description: Explicit absolute IRI of the target Registry; it need not be a retrieval endpoint.

Address.description: Current address embedded in and owned by the household Record.

addressLines.description: Complete ordered address lines, bounded to three in this profile.

locality.description: Locality label recorded for this household address.

postalCode.description: Postal code as a string; leading zeroes are retained. Omitted when not recorded for this view.

HouseholdMembership.description: Household-owned membership component. membershipId identifies it within the household; role describes the relationship to the referenced individual.

membershipId.description: Stable component identifier unique within its household.

role.description: REFERENCE_PERSON identifies the administrative reference person; MEMBER identifies another recorded member. This profile uses a closed vocabulary.

HouseholdData.description: Current household view with an embedded address and complete permitted membership components. Individual identities are carried as references.

memberships.description: Complete permitted memberships ordered by membershipId in Unicode scalar order. This profile accepts up to 20 components; overflow fails the read.

HouseholdRecord.description: Record in https://registry.example/registries/households with the typed household view and an extensible envelope.

ParentAtRegistration.description: Parent details captured by the birth registration. nameAtRegistration retains its recorded meaning. individualRef is not required and supplies related Record identity when available.

nameAtRegistration.description: Parent name captured at registration, preserved as a historical fact.

BirthRegistrationData.description: Recorded birth event and parent details in the fixed registration view.

dateOfBirth.description: Calendar date of birth as recorded by this registration.

placeOfBirth.description: Place of birth label captured by the registration.

registrationEffectiveFrom.description: First calendar date on which this registry Record version is applicable. This Record-applicability coordinate is distinct from dateOfBirth, which describes the civil-registration event.

parents.description: Complete permitted parent components in source registration order. This profile accepts up to four components; overflow fails the read.

BirthRegistrationRecord.description: Record in https://registry.example/registries/birth-registrations with recorded parent data and any related Record references.

BirthRegistrationEffectiveAt.description: Calendar date selecting Record applicability. registrationEffectiveFrom is inclusive; instant values and implicit timezone conversion are not supported.

BirthRegistrationTemporalSelection.description: Birth-profile temporal selection: recordedAsOf is a UTC instant with Z, while effectiveAt is a calendar date only.

allOf.description: The birth profile narrows effective-time selection to calendar dates.

BirthRegistrationTemporalMetadata.description: Source-backed temporal echo for the birth profile, preserving UTC recording instants and date-only applicability coordinates.

allOf.description: Returned effectiveAt coordinates are calendar dates without timezone conversion.

BirthRegistrationTemporalRecord.description: Temporal-capable birth-registration Record. temporal is omitted for current state and present with source-backed echoed coordinates when temporal selection is used.

allOf.description: Top-level temporal metadata, when supplied, is typed by the shared temporal contract.

BirthRegistrationRevision.description: One retained source revision of a birth-registration Record under current disclosure policy.

allOf.description: Retained history requires source-backed revision identity.

BirthRegistrationPage.description: A bounded current or temporally selected page. Page-level temporal metadata echoes a selection even when items is empty; item metadata remains not required.

allOf.description: Current and temporally selected results share the same birth-registration Record view.

items.description: Birth-registration Records in the declared search order.

BirthRegistrationTemporalPage.description: Birth-registration page returned for a declared temporal selection, including empty pages.

BirthRegistrationRevisionPage.description: A bounded page of retained birth-registration revisions.

allOf.description: Revision pages narrow each item to a birth-registration revision.

items.description: Retained birth-registration revisions in descending recording order.

OccurrencePeriod.description: Inclusive range of birth-event dates. At least one date bound is required.

allOf.description: This named search narrows both reusable range bounds to calendar dates.

OccurrencePeriodAndPlaceCriteria.description: Typed civil-registration event criteria: an inclusive date-of-birth range and a declared place-label prefix.

BirthRegistrationSearchRequest.description: Named typed search by occurrence period and place, with temporal selection (when declared) and continuation controls.

search.description: Published named search for occurrence-period and place-prefix criteria.
